record.bible_text: I saw<WH07200><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> standing<WH05324><WTH8737> upon the altar<WH04196>: and he said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Smite<WH05221><WTH8685> the lintel of the door<WH03730>, that the posts<WH05592> may shake<WH07493><WTH8799>: and cut<WH01214><WTH8798> them in the head<WH07218>, all of them; and I will slay<WH02026><WTH8799> the last<WH0319> of them with the sword<WH02719>: he that fleeth<WH05127><WTH8801> of them shall not flee away<WH05127><WTH8799>, and he that escapeth<WH06412> of them shall not be delivered<WH04422><WTH8735>. <RF>lintel: or, chapiter, or, knop<Rf> <RF>cut...: or, wound them<Rf>
